milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the red bed (located at spawn-relative [1, 0, 6.5] — midpoint of foot and head blocks) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bed.
